metadata.title: Full-Stack Analytics Pipeline & Governance — Buendía Tours
metadata.description: How I built an end-to-end ETL pipeline from browser to BigQuery for a Spanish travel agency, enabling real-time marketing attribution dashboards and 100% GDPR compliance via OneTrust/GTM integration.

blocks.title: Full-Stack Analytics Pipeline & Governance: Buendía Tours
blocks.challengeBody: Buendía Tours needed to move beyond basic reporting to a sophisticated, data-driven marketing strategy. The primary hurdles were a lack of raw data access for deep analysis, inconsistent event tracking across their Drupal-based site, and the urgent need to comply with stringent EU privacy regulations (GDPR) without losing marketing visibility.

solutionItems.title: End-to-End ETL Orchestration
solutionItems.description: Designed the automated pipeline to flow from the browser to BigQuery. By bypassing the limitations of the GA4 UI, I enabled the team to perform complex SQL-based attribution modeling and lifetime value (LTV) analysis.

solutionItems.title: Automated Event Framework
solutionItems.description: Instead of manual tagging for every new tour or landing page, I engineered a dynamic framework between the Drupal backend and GTM. This utilized a standardized dataLayer schema that auto-populated event parameters based on site metadata.

solutionItems.title: Privacy-First Governance
solutionItems.description: Authored a comprehensive Data Governance guide and integrated OneTrust consent signals directly into GTM. This ensured that tracking only fired when legal consent was present, protecting the brand from compliance risks.

blocks.ahaBody: By centralizing the data in BigQuery, we were able to join website behavior with booking data. We discovered that a significant portion of "lost" conversions weren't due to price, but due to users checking the "meeting point" maps on mobile and getting lost in a navigation loop. This insight allowed the team to prioritize a UI fix for the map integration.

impactItems.label: Implementation Velocity — reduction in time to deploy new tracking events through the automated framework
Data Accessibility — enabled real-time marketing attribution dashboards, allowing budget to shift to high-performing channels instantly
Regulatory Compliance — alignment with GDPR standards through the OneTrust/GTM integration
Technical Debt Reduction — eliminated hard-coded tags, creating a clean, maintainable GTM container
